retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban collage featuring oversized, distressed sans-serif typography layered over currency and saturated red/yellow highlights with heavy film grain.
triggerTerms: urban collage with currency and grain
oversized bold sans-serif with halftone texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, layered composition where massive, textured block letters dominate the frame, partially obscuring a background of currency notes and a central vertical burst of saturated red and yellow light, all unified by a heavy, noisy film grain and high-contrast shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Oversized typography layered over currency imagery
High-contrast black background vs. bright white distressed text
Central vertical color gradient (red to yellow) cutting through the center
Heavy halftone and noise texture applied across all elements
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and digital noise
Distressed, eroded edges on large display type
Deep black negative space at the edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two rows of massive, frame-filling display text occupy the top and middle thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical red/yellow light streak acts as a spine for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top large text, move down to the second row of large text, and settle on the smaller yellow subtitle at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black borders and gaps between letters provide high-contrast relief.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated Red and Yellow (central glow and subtitle)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black background; high saturation in the central light burst.

letterConstructionRules: Subtle drop shadows to separate from background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Glyphs feature irregular 'bitten' edges to simulate old print degradation
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Massive distressed display type paired with clean, widely-spaced secondary type for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary bold, condensed skeleton for the display text.
Offers a sturdy base for the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark urban collage on a black background. Include a central vertical streak of glowing red and yellow light. Layer semi-transparent, grainy images of currency notes (dollars) behind the light. Apply a heavy film grain and halftone filter over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two rows of massive, white, condensed sans-serif text in the upper two-thirds. Apply a distressed 'photocopy' texture and eroded edges to the letters. Add a small, clean, yellow sans-serif subtitle at the bottom with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?
Does the display text have eroded, distressed edges?
Is the central light burst saturated red and yellow?
Is the subtitle yellow and widely spaced?

mustRedesign: Any recognizable logos or brand marks
Exact layout of the currency notes
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite distress
Verify the halftone pattern is consistent
Check that the black background is deep and noisy
Confirm the yellow subtitle is centered and clear
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Urban/Street Imagery] with [Texture: Distressed Photocopy/Grain] and [Type: Massive Condensed Sans-Serif] using a [Palette: Black/White/Saturated Accent] color scheme.
